neighbours.label: The preposition ('with', 'to') after a word for a spiritual bond: connection or harmony with nature, spirit or unseen beings, not a practical link
fire: Meditation deepens your bond with the divine and with your inner self.
The ritual restores our communion with ancestors and spirits of the forest.
Yoga helps you cultivate a sacred relationship with your higher self.
Walking barefoot strengthens your connection with the earth and its healing energy.
Many healers speak of their spiritual connection to angels and unseen beings.
Through prayer she found a profound union with the cosmos.
Shamans seek harmony with the spirits of animals and rivers.
This retreat will reawaken your deep connection with the soul of nature.
quiet: The meeting deepened our contract with the vendor and with its lawyers.
The software restores our link with servers and databases of the company.
Training helps you cultivate a working relationship with your new manager.
A new road improves our town's connection with the highway and its bus depot.
Many technicians speak of their network connection to printers and office machines.
Through a merger she found a profitable partnership with the bank.
Engineers seek compatibility with the drivers of printers and scanners.
This adapter will restore your wireless connection with the printer in the office.

notes: The output suppresses ' connect*'. The - pole is the idiom side ('in tune', 'one with', 'getting back to').
